s: January 29, 2025 - It originates from the Latin word “quotidianus,” which means “daily.” In contemporary usage, “quotidian” often conveys a sense of routine or normalcy, but it can also carry a slightly more formal or literary tone. For example, one might say, “The quotidian tasks of life often go unnoticed,” highlighting the mundane yet essential activities that fill our days.
